none: PAS CAM-632E16: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ FEL TEMP [REPARATIO] ; D/ D N CONSTAN[...]

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine. AD348-350, (Reece period 18). Reverse legend reads FEL TEMP [REPARATIO]. Reverse shows Soldier leading small figure from hut. Mint unknown. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust left, holding globe. Obverse legend reads D N CONSTAN[...]. Reverse fields and exergue is read: / //[...]. Condition is fine, die axis is 6 o'clock,…
